title: Freedom Yield Metal — A-chain Anchor History v3 (chain-discriminated lines)
description: Per-line contract for v3 lines of /api/anchor-history.jsonl. v3 = v2 plus REQUIRED chain_id, block_id and chain_profile, mirrored from a v3 anchor receipt (see /api/anchor-receipt.schema.v3.json). The ledger is append-only and may hold v1, v2 and v3 lines; consumers MUST validate each line against the schema its own schema_version names. Lines without chain_id (v2 lines written before 2026-09-30, and any v2 line whose receipt carried none) are on the legacy XPR Network chain of their network: mainnet 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0, testnet 71ee83bcf52142d61019d95f9cc5427ba6a0d7ff8accd9e2088ae2abeaf3d3dd. Companion generator: scripts/append-anchor-history.sh.
x-line-encoding: JSONL — UTF-8, one JSON object per line, lines terminated by LF (0x0A) including the final line, no trailing blank lines. Schema describes the per-line object shape; consumers MUST validate each line independently.
x-append-only-invariants: tx_id is unique across all lines
(cycle_number, event_type) pair is unique for cyclestart/cycleend event_type
(key_seq, 'idrotate') pair is unique for idrotate event_type
cycle_number strictly non-decreasing across lines that carry it

block_num non-decreasing across consecutive lines of the same chain_id (a line without chain_id counts as the legacy XPR chain_id of its network). A line whose chain_id differs from the previous line's starts a new era: allowed only when that chain_id is the one the writer's selected, reviewed chain profile carries; an unknown chain_id, or a return to an earlier era's chain_id, is refused
prev_anchor_tx_id of line N equals tx_id of line N-1 (hash chain by tx reference; null only for genesis line)
existing lines are byte-for-byte immutable; only legal write is appending a new line
file terminates with LF on the final line

cycle_number.description: Present for cyclestart/cycleend. Absent for idrotate.

key_seq.description: Present for idrotate. The identity key generation counter.

chain_backend.description: Protocol-family label mirrored from anchor-receipt.anchor.chain_backend — not an execution engine. For metal-a-chain this is 'antelope'; the lines published for the cycle 3 and cycle 4 anchors carry 'pulsevm', a forward-looking label naming an announced future execution engine rather than the family observed serving the chain. This ledger is append-only, so those lines keep the value they were published with.

prev_anchor_tx_id.description: tx_id of the previous line. Null for the genesis line. Enables hash-chain-by-tx traversal.

archived_source_path.description: R18 (2026-07-08, additive): repo-relative path to the per-anchor, content-addressed archive copy of the anchor-source.json pre-image that produced this line's dag_root_hash, e.g. 'api/archive/anchor-source-<dag_root_hash>.json'. Written by scripts/gen-anchor-source.sh at generation time. Absent on lines appended before this field existed — its absence does not imply the archive copy itself is missing, only that this pointer predates R18.

archived_receipt_path.description: R18 (2026-07-08, additive): repo-relative path to the per-anchor, content-addressed archive copy of the anchor-receipt.json for this line's tx_id, e.g. 'api/archive/anchor-receipt-<tx_id>.json'. Written by scripts/gen-anchor-receipt.sh at generation time. Absent on lines appended before this field existed.

chain_id.description: chain_id of the A-Chain the transaction of this line is on, taken from the reviewed chain profile (config/a-chain-profiles.json) the generator ran under and reconciled with FYD_<ROLE>_CHAIN_ID. The history base that resolved the tx is bound to this chain_id by that profile's allowlist. Lines from before this field existed are on the legacy XPR Network chain (mainnet 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0). Mirrored from anchor-receipt.anchor.chain_id. REQUIRED in v3.

block_id.description: id of the block holding the transaction, as served by the history base (Hyperion action block_id) or by /v1/chain/get_block on the same base. With chain_id it identifies the block unambiguously across a chain migration, where block_num alone may not. Mirrored from anchor-receipt.anchor.block_id; absent when the receipt carried none. REQUIRED in v3.

chain_profile.description: name of the chain profile (config/a-chain-profiles.json) the generator ran under, e.g. 'xpr-mainnet'. Mirrored from anchor-receipt.anchor.chain_profile. REQUIRED in v3.
